resources.string: Lets an RWKV model schedule the presets set to RWKV-Instant or RWKV-Curve in deck options. Needs imported model files and enough memory.
Not available: this phone has too little memory for your collection. Scheduling is unchanged.
Not available: import an RWKV two-head model first. Scheduling is unchanged.
Not available: the RWKV engine could not load the model files. Scheduling is unchanged.
On: RWKV schedules the presets set to RWKV in deck options.

AnkiQuest ships no RWKV weights: they have no licence for redistribution and are for personal and research use only (WEIGHTS-NOTICE.md of the %1$s release of JSchoreels/anki-rwkv). Download fetches a size\'s models from that release on GitHub. Or download its two-head zip, and if you like the Instant-only zip of the same size, yourself and choose the zips or their weights.f32.bin files. Only files whose SHA-256 matches a known model are kept.
Not downloaded: no connection to GitHub.
Not downloaded: the file does not match the known RWKV model.
Not imported: no file matches a known RWKV model.
Not imported: the file could not be read.
